plotSections.title: Fused lantern-staff
bullets: The lantern and staff are fused, and the same incantation reproducibly blinds people who look at it. Sylan avoided the effect by not looking. Gerk was blinded while insisting he was off to the side and does not know whether he looked.
While others are blinded, the user sees a grayscale ethereal scene. Ord identifies an evocation aura and sees spirits attached to Sylan.
When Sylan grabbed the staff to help Ord, a black pillar shot up and the spirits were drawn into Sylan. He wants the blind function for Ord in a fight and the spirit-gathering effect for himself.

plotSections.title: Six New Navel spirits
bullets: Six spirits are back with Sylan. The party will not describe them beyond that they seem to be people of New Navel, not people of a guild, with gripes against some people there and possible unfinished business.
Sylan thinks he might be able to speak with them if he goes to his own realm, and he is not sure. He proposes a New Navel ghost investigation before the lich and his sister.
The party agrees to go after dinner. Ciri wants in. Gerk does not want to be cursed or to play ghost cop, and Sylan calls him a strong Karnak Mar, a skeptic to the pair.

plotSections.title: Walker, Vecna, and the map token
bullets: Walker returns from the old training grounds, where he had a short talk with Vecna. He says they might have made a deal, then that they did not really, only that they have common interests: Vecna wants his sister-skin book back.

After that meeting, Walker produces a golden eagle. Placed on the war-table map, it lights the map. He thinks it is only half of a pair and that the other half may be at the palace Vecna operated from in Nyx, a headquarters with a big red wall.
No one can name that capital. Sylan and Dana recall going back to a seasman or season that, to Dana's knowledge, was shattered in pieces on the floor.

chronologicalEvents: 1. Sylan and Ord retest the fused lantern-staff. The blind incantation works again. Sylan is unaffected if he does not look. Gerk is blinded and cannot say whether he was looking.
2. Ord reports a reproducible blinding effect, an evocation aura, and grayscale ethereal sight, during which he sees spirits attached to Sylan. Sylan can also see them once he takes the staff.
3. A black pillar rises and all six spirits are drawn into Sylan. They appear to be New Navel dead with unfinished business. Sylan may try to speak with them in his realm.
4. The party agrees to investigate that in New Navel after dinner, ahead of the lich and Sylan's sister. Ciri joins. Walker is back and still himself.
5. Walker says he met Vecna at the old training grounds. Vecna wants the sister-skin book back. Walker calls it common interest rather than a real deal.

6. Walker's golden eagle lights the war-table map. He believes it is half of a set and that the other half may be in Vecna's old Nyx palace, the headquarters with the big red wall. The capital's name is not settled.
7. In connection with that lead, the party recalls a seasman or season they returned to, which Dana says was shattered on the floor.

Fused lantern-staff.existing: Lantern and staff fused together; the active staff reveals the Ethereal Plane and draws nearby spirits.
notes: The fusion is confirmed, and the same incantation reproducibly blinds people who look at the lantern.
The effect has an evocation aura. While others are blinded, the user sees a grayscale ethereal scene.
When Sylan held it against the spirits, a black pillar shot up and the spirits were pulled into him rather than into the staff.
Sylan expects a blind function for Ord and a spirit-gathering function for himself, and he wants it available in combat.
He can ignore the lantern's blindness by not looking at it, and grabbing the staff let him see the spirits as the black pillar rose.
All six spirits are with him now. He believes they are New Navel dead with grudges, and that he might converse with them in his own realm.
He proposes doing that New Navel investigation tonight after dinner, and treating the lich and freeing his sister as later business.
Walker treats him as someone from the Nyx capital whose name the party cannot recall.
personality: Treats the haunting as a case to investigate and Gerk as the skeptic paired with him.
quotesThemes: Maybe it has a blind future for you, Ord, and with my darker inclination a spirit gathering for me.
I suspect that if I go to my realm, I might be able to converse with them, but I'm not sure.
openQuestions: Can Sylan converse with the six spirits if he goes to his realm?

notes: He repeated the same incantation and confirmed that it blinds onlookers.
During the blindness he saw a grayscale ethereal place, an evocation aura, and the spirits attached to Sylan.
He also saw that Sylan could see those spirits after taking the staff.
quotesThemes: The same incantation does in fact reproducibly blind people.

notes: The lantern blinded him again even though he says he was apart from Sylan and Ord, doing his own thing. He does not know whether he looked at it.
He wants compensation for the harassment and does not want to be cursed or to join the ghost investigation.
Sylan calls him a strong Karnak Mar, a skeptic counterpart to Sylan's ghost-whispering.
personality: Feels personally victimized by the blinding and is wary of curses.
quotesThemes: I was blinded and I just feel personally victimized.
I don't want to be cursed.
openQuestions: Was Gerk looking at the lantern when it blinded him?

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter bonded to Glimmen.
notes: He flies back in and is still himself. He had planned to tell his story over dinner, and the party is waiting until then to leave.
At the old training grounds he had a short conversation with Vecna. He first says they might have made a deal, then that it was not really a deal, only common interests.
Vecna wants his sister-skin book back.
Walker has a golden eagle that lights the war-table map and believes it is only one half, with the mate possibly at Vecna's former palace in Nyx.
personality: Downplays the Vecna meeting as shared interest rather than a bargain.
quotesThemes: He wants the book. He wants his sister skin book back.
openQuestions: What, if anything, did Walker agree to with Vecna beyond the shared wish to recover the sister-skin book?

Vecna.existing: Elder god of liches who wants hidden knowledge, including the Raskina made from his sister.
notes: Walker met him at the old training grounds for a quick talk and describes common interests rather than a firm deal.
He wants his sister-skin book back.
He was tapping something before Walker brought out the golden eagle.
He formerly operated from a palace in Nyx, described as headquarters with a big red wall, where Walker thinks the other half of the map token may be.

Raskina.existing: Vecna's red-skinned tome, made from his sister and held by Grixto.
notes: Walker tells the party that what Vecna wants from their common interest is this sister-skin book back.
quotesThemes: He wants his sister skin book back.

Glade spirits.existing: Ethereal spirits drawn to the lantern and pulled into Sylan.
notes: There are six, and they are attached to Sylan. Ord saw them on the ethereal grayscale while the lantern blinded others. Sylan saw them after taking the staff.
The black pillar drew them into Sylan, not into the staff, and all six are with him again.
Interrogation, which the party will not detail, makes them seem to be people of New Navel with gripes against some people there and possible unfinished business.
Sylan hopes his own realm might let him speak with them.
openQuestions: Will Sylan's realm let him converse with the six New Navel spirits?

New Navel.existing: Familiar stop whose dead can return as celestial echoes, and whose sheriff bans doors and spirit-taking in the city.
notes: The six spirits on Sylan seem to be New Navel people with unfinished business and grudges against some locals.
The party plans a ghost investigation there after dinner, before pursuing the lich and Sylan's sister.

Nyx.existing: A place that may hold hobgoblins who know where the lich is hiding.
notes: Walker says Vecna operated out of a palace there, a headquarters with a big red wall, and that the other half of the golden-eagle map token might be there.
The party cannot name the capital. Walker appeals to Sylan as someone from there.
Guesses heard in the talk are Allen Boo, Alibu, Next City, and New Next City.
openQuestions: What is the name of the Nyx capital, and where is the red-wall palace headquarters?

Training Grounds.existing: Training grounds near the Lost Isles.
notes: Walker went to the old training grounds and met Vecna there.

Hunched eagle marker.existing: High-ranking hunched eagle that Elrus calls a hobgoblin legion standard. Troop markers on the cave floor are read by the table as a landmark map.
notes: Walker pulls out what he calls a golden eagle after Vecna was tapping something. Set on the war-table map, it lights the map.
He thinks this piece is only half and that its counterpart may be at Vecna's old headquarters in Nyx.
quotesThemes: I think this is only half. And I think the other half might be back in Nyx.
openQuestions: Is the golden eagle the hunched eagle marker, and is there a second half at the Nyx palace?

notes: She joins the New Navel plan as soon as she hears about sucking in souls. Sylan assigns her to what he calls the vice division.
Sylan thinks she is hiding in a tree and might be blinded but will not admit it. She is standing directly behind Walker. The DM confirms the whole party is present.
quotesThemes: All I heard was sucking in souls, so I'm in.

Can Sylan speak with the six spirits if he goes to his realm?
What is the Nyx capital called, and where is the palace headquarters with the big red wall?

newTerms.name: Karnak Mar
notes: Orc term Sylan applies to Gerk. He pairs it with skeptic: Gerk is the skeptic to Sylan's ghost-whispering, and Gerk answers that he is Sylan's skullly. Gerk's own line in the exchange is Shadows are lost you live.

newTerms.name: Golden eagle
notes: Token Walker produced after meeting Vecna. Placed on the war-table map, it lights the map. Walker thinks it is one half of a pair and that the other half may be at Vecna's former palace in Nyx. It may be the hunched eagle marker under a bad hearing.
